description: Save a learned travel preference or experience to the user's traveler profile. Use when the user shares preferences, likes, dislikes, or trip experiences that should inform future recommendations. Examples: 'Prefers boutique hotels over chains', 'Always takes a window seat', 'Vegetarian — recommend plant-based restaurants', 'Hated ground floor rooms'. Don't save temporary logistics like 'my flight lands at 3pm'. Entries are appended, so saving one preference never overwrites another.

profile_entry.description: The preference or experience to save. Be specific and actionable. Good: 'Prefers ocean-view rooms'. Bad: 'Liked the hotel'.

name: update_traveler_profile
